basic_info.description: Amazingly remodeled and customized gem of a home in highly sought after Bernal Heights neighborhood.  Entire home has been re-invented for a modern lifestyle with quality upgrades and finishes.  Must see to appreciate.   Main level offers an open floor-plan with a den, dining area and updated working kitchen, designed for a cook and offering high-end appliances. Main floor also offers a half bath with laundry room.  Top floor is dedicated to the primary suite. Large windows flood this area with natural light. Grand-sized walk-in closet and private en-suite bath.  Lower level offers a second family den, a full bath, and an additional bedroom. High ceilings and easy access to the back yard area. Close proximity to Cortland Ave. Do not miss out on this gem of a property!
